messages:
Lena T: Hi - I'm 60% FTE contractor. Our local office observed Founders Day (Jun 18) but the company had a mandatory maintenance blackout that week, so I couldn't take the day. Can this be carried over or paid out? cc @People Ops
People Ops: Hey Lena 00 short version: for contractors we pro-rate statutory/company holidays. If the holiday fell inside a mandatory blackout and you reasonably couldn't take it, HR can approve carryover pro-rata or a one-time payout. We need manager confirmation + the blackout-exception form.
Lena T: Thanks. Which form and where to upload the contract?
People Ops: Use https://intranet.redwood/hr-forms/blackout-exception and attach your contract + a brief manager note. Policy snippet: "Contractors and part-time staff: pro-rated holiday entitlements; blackout exceptions may result in carryover or payout subject to local law and HR approval."
Marco V: I confirm Lena was assigned to the on-call rotation that week and couldn't be off. I'll add a short note on the form.
People Ops: Thanks Marco  I've opened case HR-2026-5072 for tracking. If you want carryover choose "carryover" in the form; for payout choose "payout". Payroll cutoff note: request payouts at least 20 business days before payroll run to make this cycle, otherwise it's next cycle.
Lena T: Submitted form and attached Marco's note. Marked "carryover" and tagged urgent because I prefer an extra day next year.
calendar-bot: Reminder: maintenance blackout Jun 16-19 (service window). See https://calendar.redwood/blackouts
People Ops: Received. We'll calculate pro-rated hours (0.6 of a day) and confirm HR-2026-5072 status in 3-7 business days. If local law requires payout we'll advise. :white_check_mark:
